cx_house_fire.text: The smoke alarm screams at 3 a.m. Orange light is crawling under the bedroom door.

outcomes.safe: You make it out in your socks. The house does not. Insurance covers some of it.
outcomes.burned: The hallway is worse than you thought. You get out with burns and a new respect for smoke alarms.
outcomes.lucky: You get the albums and your lungs pay for it. Worth it, you decide, coughing.
outcomes.hurt: The albums survive. You spend a week in a hospital bed reading their captions.

cx_flood.text: The river tops its banks overnight. Brown water is climbing the front steps and the radio says leave.

outcomes.held: The sandbags hold. The neighbours bring beer. A flood party, technically.
outcomes.swamped: The water wins. Your carpet is now a swamp and your couch a canoe.

cx_earthquake.text: The floor lurches. Dishes sing, the lamp swings, and everything you own is briefly airborne.

outcomes.fine: You reach the lawn just as the chimney decides to leave. Everyone stands around, pale and alive.
outcomes.debris: Falling bricks have opinions about your route. You limp away with a gash and a story.

cx_passenger_crash.text: You are in the passenger seat when the driver looks at their phone for one second too long.

outcomes.minor: Metal crumples, airbags bloom. You walk away sore and permanently opinionated about phones.
outcomes.severe: The ambulance ride is a blur. Rehab is not.
outcomes.fatal: The impact is on your side. The last thing you hear is the radio.

cx_mugging.text: A man steps out of an alley, hand in his jacket. "Wallet. Phone. Now."

outcomes.won: He was bluffing. He runs; you stand there shaking, extremely proud.
outcomes.lost: He was not bluffing about the fists. You lose the wallet and a tooth.
outcomes.knife: There really was a knife. The ER doctor is unimpressed by your heroics.

cx_lost_mountains.text: The trail marker vanished three miles ago. The sun is dropping and your phone has no signal.

outcomes.found: You retrace your steps by headlamp and find the trail. Never leave without a map again.
outcomes.cold: You spend a freezing night under a rock ledge. Rescuers find you at dawn, blue and furious.
outcomes.exposure: The cold arrives politely and never leaves.
outcomes.road: Streams lead to roads. A farmer drives you back, laughing.
outcomes.ravine: The stream ends at a waterfall. You do not, thankfully, but you do slide.

cx_wedding_poisoning.text: Forty guests, one buffet, a long afternoon in the sun. By evening half the wedding is in the bathrooms.

outcomes.fast: An IV drip and a bored nurse later, you are fine. The bride is still not speaking to the caterer.
outcomes.bad: It was the bad kind. Three days of hospital soup. You never eat egg salad again.

cx_co_scare.text: Headaches, dizziness, a sleepy dread. The detector you never bought would have had something to say.

outcomes.woke: You wake up groggy, wrongly confident, and still alive. A neighbour calls the gas company.
outcomes.hospital: A friend finds you in time. Oxygen mask, dark jokes, one very expensive night.

cx_ice_pond.text: The pond looks frozen solid. Your friends are already out in the middle, daring you.

outcomes.fine: It holds. You slide around like a legend and tell nobody at home.
outcomes.crack: The ice cracks. You get wet to the neck and learn physics fast.

cx_riptide.text: The beach is gorgeous, the swim is lovely, and the shore is getting further away.

outcomes.escape: You remember the advice, swim sideways, and crawl out gasping. The lifeguard nods.
outcomes.rescued: A lifeguard drags you in. Everyone on the beach claps. You wish they would not.
outcomes.exhausted: You make it, barely, on pure stubbornness and a surfer's board.
outcomes.rescued2: The lifeguard hauls you in. You drink a surprising amount of ocean.

cx_lump.text: You find a lump. It is small, firm, and has your full attention.

outcomes.benign: Benign. The doctor says it in a bored voice, which is the best voice there is.
outcomes.caught_early: Caught early. Surgery, a rough spring, and a clean scan by autumn.
outcomes.nothing: It shrinks and vanishes. You tell no one how scared you were.
outcomes.late: Waiting was the wrong call. Treatment is long and the bills longer.

cx_chest_pains.text: A band tightens across your chest. You are sweating in an air-conditioned room.

outcomes.stent: A stent, a lecture, and a pill organizer. You are alive and slightly scolded.
outcomes.false_alarm: Heartburn. The paramedic is very kind about it.
outcomes.passed: It passes. You do not go to the doctor. This is a mistake you are fond of.
outcomes.attack: It was the real thing. You survive on luck, mostly.

cx_diagnosis.text: The doctor closes the folder before speaking. "It is a chronic condition. Manageable, not curable."

cx_surgery_decision.text: A herniated disc, a bad joint, a decision. Surgery is fast and risky; physiotherapy is slow and boring.

outcomes.success: You wake up pain-free and hungry. The surgeon is extremely smug.
outcomes.complications: An infection. Two more weeks in a hospital bed.
outcomes.died: The anesthesia was fine. The rest was not.

cx_child_fever.text: {{name}} has a fever that will not break. The thermometer shows a number you keep rechecking.

outcomes.treated: Antibiotics, fluids, a sticker. {{name}} sleeps; you do not.
outcomes.admitted: Three nights on a children's ward. {{name}} recovers; you age ten years.
outcomes.fine: The fever breaks at dawn. You pretend you were never worried.
outcomes.worse: It gets worse, and the ER is where you end up anyway, later and guiltier.

cx_mother_dementia.text: {{name}} called you by your grandmother's name, then asked where she parked the car. She has not driven in years.

cx_father_dementia.text: {{name}} left the stove on again, then insisted he did not. He gets lost in the neighbourhood he built.

cx_appendix.text: A stabbing pain on your right side keeps getting worse. Pressing on it makes you see colours.

outcomes.passes: It subsides. You were lucky and a bit stupid.
outcomes.burst: It bursts. Emergency surgery, a long recovery, and a doctor who says "I told you so" with her eyebrows.
outcomes.sepsis: Sepsis. Three days in ICU. The nurses remember your name; you do not remember theirs.

cx_panic_attacks.text: Your heart pounds in a supermarket aisle. The walls lean in. You are fairly sure you are dying, over the cereal.

cx_vision_loss.text: A curtain drops over the left side of your vision. Doctors use the word "urgent" twice.

outcomes.partial: You keep most of it. The world has a permanent blur at the edges.
outcomes.lucky: The drops work. Nobody is more surprised than the optometrist.
outcomes.damage: The damage is permanent. You learn to love large fonts.

cx_bag_of_cash.text: Behind a dumpster sits a gym bag stuffed with cash. Nobody is around. A security camera points elsewhere.

outcomes.clean: Nobody ever asks. You spend months checking over your shoulder anyway.
outcomes.dirty: The money was not lost, it was hidden. Some men come looking, and it costs you.

cx_hit_and_run.text: A car clips a cyclist at the crossing and keeps going. You got the first three letters of the plate.

cx_lie_to_police.text: {{name}} turns up at midnight, wired. "If anyone asks, I was with you tonight. All night. Please."

outcomes.works: The police buy it. {{name}} owes you a favour and a very quiet silence.
outcomes.caught: It unravels in one interview. Obstruction fines and a record. {{name}} stops answering your calls.

cx_falsify_report.text: Your boss slides a spreadsheet across the desk. "Just round these numbers up. Everyone does."

outcomes.bonus: The quarter looks great. Your bonus lands. Your appetite leaves.
outcomes.audit: An audit finds it. The boss blames "the numbers person." That is you.

cx_affair_partner.text: A coworker keeps finding reasons to stand close. Tonight the hotel bar offers a "quiet drink." {{name}} thinks you are working late.

outcomes.secret: Nobody finds out. Yet. Your secret has a weight you did not budget for.
outcomes.exposed: A friend sees you. The photo is in {{name}}'s phone by morning.

cx_affair_spouse.text: An old flame sends a message: "I am in town. Dinner?" {{name}} is asleep one room away.

outcomes.secret: It stays a secret and a stone in your shoe.
outcomes.exposed: {{name}} finds the receipts, then the messages. The silence at home is polite and total.

cx_extra_change.text: The cashier hands back a fifty instead of a five. She has already turned to the next customer.

choices.donate: Slip it in a tip jar

outcomes.seen: A stranger sees. Silent respect, in a queue.
outcomes.unseen: Nobody notices. That is sort of the point.

cx_whistleblow.text: You find proof your company has been dumping waste into the river. Management would prefer it stays a rumor.

outcomes.hero: The story breaks. The fine is enormous; so is the applause.
outcomes.fired: You are escorted out with a box. The river is cleaner. Your bank account is not.

cx_inheritance_feud_1.text: The will is read. {{name}} gets the house; you get the clock. Neither of you says a word, which is how a feud begins.

cx_inheritance_feud_2.text: Months later, your sibling's lawyer sends a letter. The clock, it turns out, was worth more than the house.

outcomes.wins: The court sides with you. The family dinner becomes a cold war.
outcomes.loses: The court does not. Lawyers eat well that month.

cx_investment_scam.text: A smooth voice promises 40% returns "with zero risk." There is a brochure. There is always a brochure.

outcomes.gone: The website goes dark by Thursday. So does the phone number.
outcomes.paid: You actually get paid. You are insufferable about it for years.

cx_market_crash.text: The market falls off a cliff. Your savings statement arrives and you look at it through your fingers.

outcomes.recover: The market rebounds. You nap through your own hero's arc.
outcomes.bleed: It keeps falling, then falls some more.
outcomes.locked: You lock in the loss. At least you can describe it exactly.
outcomes.lucky: You sell near the bottom, but not at it. Small mercies.

cx_lawsuit.text: A man slips on your wet porch, and a letter with a lot of capital letters arrives. "WE DEMAND COMPENSATION."

outcomes.win: The judge dismisses it. Your lawyer bills you for the joy.
outcomes.lose: You lose. The man now owns a lovely new pair of shoes and your porch.

cx_identity_theft.text: A credit card you never opened is maxed out in a city you have never visited. Someone is wearing your name.

outcomes.fades: It quietly fades. Somebody else's problem now.
outcomes.grows: Loans appear. Debt collectors call. You spend a year proving you are you.

cx_sibling_bailout.text: {{name}} calls at midnight. Bail, rent, a loan shark: the list changes every time. "I just need ten grand."

outcomes.repaid: {{name}} actually pays you back, in installments and with guilt.
outcomes.burned: The money vanishes. So does {{name}}, for six months.

cx_gambling_1.text: A cousin takes you to a casino "just for the buffet." Slot lights blink. You have a hot streak.

outcomes.win: You leave with a stack of chips and a dangerous idea.
outcomes.lose: The streak ends. The hunger does not.

cx_gambling_2.text: You are down again. A friend suggests a "sure thing" at the track. Rent is due Friday.

outcomes.wipe: The horse has other priorities. So do the lenders.
outcomes.recoup: It pays. You swear it was the last time. You say that often.

cx_rug_pull.text: A coworker swears a new digital coin "is the future." Everyone in the break room is already in.

outcomes.moon: It triples and you cash out like a monk. Rare.
outcomes.rug: The founders vanish with the money and a boat. The coin is now a screensaver.

cx_contractor_fraud.text: The contractor takes a 50% deposit for your kitchen. Then he stops answering the phone.

outcomes.recover: The judge orders restitution. Your kitchen is still a hole, but a vindicated one.
outcomes.nothing: He has no assets and no shame. You win a piece of paper.

cx_tax_audit.text: A formal letter arrives. The tax office would like a word, and also three years of receipts.

outcomes.clean: Everything checks out. The clerk nearly smiles.
outcomes.owe: A mistake from year two costs you a surprising sum.

cx_stalker_1.text: The same stranger appears at your bus stop, your gym, your café. Today he waved. You have never met him.

cx_stalker_2.text: Flowers on your doorstep. A note: "I like your jacket." Your window is open a hand's width wider than you left it.

cx_stalker_3.text: Headlights outside at 2 a.m. A figure walks up your path. The doorbell camera sees everything.

outcomes.arrested: He steps back and the police are already pulling up. The restraining order lands by Tuesday.
outcomes.hurt: He lunges. A neighbour's dog and a bat end it, but not before you are hurt.
outcomes.gone: By the time you open, he is gone. The silence is the worst part.

cx_startup_1.text: {{name}} has an idea, a laptop, and a trembling optimism. "Be my co-founder. We start Monday."

outcomes.pitch_good: Your pitch lands. An investor says "interesting." You hold on to that word for weeks.
outcomes.pitch_bad: Nobody gets the pitch. A VC checks his watch.

cx_startup_2.text: Eight months in, the cash is gone and the deadline is Thursday. {{name}} offers pizza and a motivational speech.

outcomes.ship: You ship at sunrise. The server crashes. The product, miraculously, does not.
outcomes.burnout: You deliver something and collapse. The product is fine; you are not.

cx_startup_3.text: A bigger company wants to buy the startup. Or the money runs out. It is genuinely hard to tell which.

outcomes.exit: You sell. The check clears. Your friend cries; so do you, in the car.
outcomes.bust: The deal falls through. The servers are shut off on a Tuesday. You keep the hoodies.

cx_mystery_illness_1.text: Unexplained fatigue, odd rashes, a pain that moves around. Three doctors have shrugged in three different accents.

cx_mystery_illness_2.text: A specialist finally has a theory, and a test that costs more than your couch.

outcomes.answer: There is a name for it, and a pill. You cry in the parking lot from pure relief.
outcomes.inconclusive: Inconclusive. Everyone looks sorry. The fatigue persists.

cx_lost_pet_1.text: Your pet slipped out the door at dawn. The leash is on its hook. The street is quiet in all the wrong ways.

cx_lost_pet_2.text: The phone rings after three days. A voice says, "I think I have your pet. It ate my sandwich."

outcomes.joy: Wet nose, crooked tail, and a full-body wiggle. You cry in front of a stranger.
outcomes.wrong: It is not your pet. The caller is crushed; you are crushed; the sandwich is long gone.

cx_lucky_ticket.text: You buy a scratch card with your change. Six symbols line up. Surely you are misreading it.

cx_meet_hero.text: Your childhood hero is three tables away, eating soup. Your heart does something athletic.

outcomes.kind: They are warm, signed a napkin, and asked about you. You frame the napkin.
outcomes.rude: They are curt. You learn something about heroes, and about soup.

cx_viral_kindness.text: You help a stranger carry their groceries up four floors. Someone films it. By morning it has 3 million views.

outcomes.sponsor: A grocery chain offers a modest sponsorship. Integrity takes a small nap.
outcomes.backlash: People notice the new sponsor. The internet decides you were never kind, only strategic.

cx_time_capsule.text: A construction crew digs up a time capsule from your school. Your name is on one envelope. You were eleven.

cx_lost_relative_letter.text: A letter arrives from a country you have never visited. It begins, "I think I am your cousin. Our grandfathers were brothers."

outcomes.warm: Letters become calls, calls become a trip. You have a whole new branch of the family tree.
outcomes.awkward: Politely strange. You exchange holiday cards and nothing else.
